scope: Native Kodi color-dialog layout in HorizonzV only; separate from the retained optional BG colorpicker addon call.

sources.finding: The native dialog loads DialogColorPicker.xml, registers control 6 as a view container, fills it with palette items, uses heading 1 and cancel button 7, and returns a confirmed Label2 color.
Published master retains the same dialog filename, view registration and control IDs when inspected.
Official reference uses a panel for control 6 and has no music-playlist content source.
Skin.SetColor opens the native dialog and writes the skin setting only on confirmation. It supplies a palette, not the complete BG helper feature set.
Skin.SetColor remains registered on published master.
Base Process writes body text to controls starting at 2. The attempted count label with ID 2 is overwritten; the skin now binds an independent count label 20 to Container(6).NumItems.

baseline.finding: Visible native dialog has no colors, no heading and no selectable palette item, despite no log ERROR. Control 6 was a group instead of a view container.

changes: Use panel 6 with explicit dimensions fitting the existing scrollbar position.
Remove unrelated Music_Albums_random.xsp content: native dialog supplies palette items.
Replace unrelated SelectLabel with independent count label 20; avoid base body-text IDs.

result: Four phases passed: Back cancel, select, reopening with selected-color preselection and Back cancel, explicit cancel button. All 162 default palette colors reported, correct heading/count, zero ERROR lines, secured settings restored.

intermediate_reports.finding: Panel and heading work, but attempted count control 2 reads empty.
Adding a dynamic count binding on ID 2 still gets overwritten.
Python ControlLabel proxy returns an empty label even for visibly populated heading 1. Not used as native-label proof in final test; native GUI info and screenshot used.

limits: This is a malformed supported-dialog contract, not proof that a Kodi API was recently removed.
Only native Skin.SetColor with isolated test setting and default Kodi palette, at 16:9; no real subtitle-setting workflow, custom palette, pointer, all aspect ratios or scrollbar traversal tested.
The optional external BG picker remains available with its documented limitations; no feature reduction by replacing it with the native palette.
Temporary CU LRC autostart isolation only in secured test settings; restored after each run.

bounded_static_check.scope: Known literal regressions and selected XML structures; not a complete control-contract parser.
